profile.org_note: Founder-led private company with a management shareholder group. Homebuilding runs through two Homes by WestBay divisions (North and South) plus the Casa Fresca Homes subsidiary; land is bought and developed centrally through HBWB Development under Mark Metheny, and finance sits with Beth Bradburn (COO, former CFO), an incoming CFO whose name is not public, and a treasurer. Succession plan: at end of 2027 Willy Nunn becomes CEO and board chair, Metheny becomes president, Bradburn retires. Corporate office: 4065 Crescent Park Drive, Riverview, FL 33578; sales line 813-438-3838.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @westbaytampa.com (e.g. emcginnis@westbaytampa.com); based on one published address
profile.summary: Conventional for-sale homebuilder: Tampa Bay's largest locally owned private builder, founded in 2009 and led by founder Willy Nunn, with about 1,150 to 1,200 closings a year and roughly $700M of sales across move-up homes (Homes by WestBay) and entry-level homes (Casa Fresca). It builds in about 20 communities in five Florida counties and reports 11,490 owned or controlled lots, close to ten years of supply. It develops much of its own land, including four master-planned communities, and has started multifamily and build-to-rent lines, so it is a plausible land-banking customer.
